name: DPM-Solver Adaptive (12/23)
plain: An embedded pair (order 2 inside order 3, or 1 inside 2) runs with a PID step-size controller. The step count is not used at all: only the first and the last non-zero σ, and it stops there instead of jumping to zero. Rejected attempts cost model calls and the time taken varies with the error tolerance.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
t=−log σ; attempt interval [s,s+h_pid]. Order 3: x_low=DPM-2 with r₁=⅓, x_high=DPM-3. Order 2: x_low=DPM-1, x_high=DPM-2.
δ=max(atol, rtol·max(|x_low|,|x_prev|)); err=‖(x_low−x_high)/δ‖₂/√numel.
PID factor from inverse errors, passed through 1+atan(f−1); accepted if factor≥accept_safety (0.81); h always multiplied by factor.
On accept x'=x_high(+su·s_noise·n if η>0), x_prev=x_low.

props.stages: order per attempt (3 or 2), including rejected attempts; total unknown ahead of time
props.final_sigma0: Wrapper replaces a 0 end with sigmas[-2]; stops there with residual noise, no denoise-to-zero.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Node name is spelled Adaptative; exposes order, rtol, atol, h_init, pcoeff, icoeff, dcoeff, accept_safety, eta, s_noise. eta>0 makes it ancestral (su from get_ancestral_step).

label: from code
surprise: eps_cache is cleared per attempt, so a rejected step re-evaluates the model at the same s. With sigmas [σ,0], the loop never runs: zero model calls, returns input (read, not run).

audit.note: "only the first and last σ" is imprecise: when the schedule ends in 0 the code uses sigmas[-2], the last non-zero σ, as the end point (ComfyUI/comfy/samplers.py:1027-1030), so it never jumps to σ=0.
